They pick it up as soon as they're back on, and the label and reference come to (email hidden) I'll post it here too.

You're right to be, Jeff. Two dead units since the 23rd, a Monday I named myself, and you're still holding boxes you can't send. That's on us.

I'm not going to give you another promise I can't keep. What I can tell you: the approval is the only thing left, nothing else is missing, and the moment it lands the label and the reference Shop···· go to your email and here.
